## Service

A billable, one-time unit of work (implementation, onboarding, support hours): `name` and `description`. Kept separate from Plan because Plan is the recurring tier and Service is one-time or ad hoc, and the two are priced and reported differently.

```ts
import { Service } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/service';

@field service = linksTo(Service);
```

Same pricing shape as Plan: prices are separate cards that link to the Service, never a stored back-link.

### Non-goals
Does not carry an amount or a billing interval. Not a project or a delivery plan for the work.

### Example
`Service/onboarding-package`, a one-time onboarding engagement.
attributes.cardDescription: A billable, non-recurring unit (implementation, support hours, onboarding), kept separate from Plan.
